title: fhirviews: FHIR desde R y vistas tabulares con SQL on FHIR
description: Development snapshot 0.5.0.9000, R4 candidate. This is a different artifact from version 0.5.0 submitted to CRAN. R client for FHIR R4 servers and SQL on FHIR view engine. Includes explicit SQL/table mappings to Patient, Observation, Encounter, Condition and Immunization, JSON/NDJSON output, decimal precision and R4 structural checks. Clinical and national profiles require validation against their canonical definitions. Rust and R4/R6 conversion are not implemented in this snapshot.
